story_sequence.text: Beacon exposes `beacon-ceo-review` as a support/review surface for version-level or major-feature requirement challenge.
`beacon-ceo-review` can explicitly produce `expand / hold / reduce / reframe` outputs.
`ceo-review` cannot freeze truth directly and must route accepted changes through existing truth surfaces.
Beacon exposes `beacon-design-review` as a support/review surface for UI/UX decision challenge.
`design-review` owns decision challenge while `prototype` remains formal freeze/handoff when triggered.
Beacon explicitly de-overloads `prototype` so it does not default into product strategy or design-final-approval semantics.
Beacon exposes `beacon-learn` as a visible learning governance surface.
Relevant learning can be injected by default into core decision surfaces using governed progressive disclosure.
Operators can see which learning influenced the current decision, route, or warning and whether it is stale or conflicting.
Stale or conflicting learning is downgraded, flagged, or pruned instead of silently reused.
`help / status / ask / deep` explain route recommendation, evidence gaps, and learning influence in human-readable form.
`v1.4.3` preserves minimal public surface, truth-first, and gate-first discipline while adding the new review/learning surfaces.
`v1.4.3` splits the umbrella line into 3 freeze-ready subfeatures whose implementation is QA-accepted and can be aggregated as umbrella acceptance evidence.
